title: SpatioLM: Towards General Physical Spatial Intelligence in Vision-Language Models

layout.note: Uneven grid of four rounded panels with grey tabs: a tall Data & Model panel at the upper left, Spatial Perception and Spatial Understanding stacked at the right, and a full-width Downstream – Manipulation panel along the bottom; inside the capability panels a chat column sits left of a chart column.

lesson: Use one accent colour for everything that belongs to the method, and give each capability a grey-tabbed panel that pairs one or two real question-answer bubbles with a small chart of scores against the best existing model; a data-and-model panel states the scale in outlined headline boxes over a faded thumbnail mosaic.
